lines.text: Your call won't connect, but a text still gets through?
A call needs a path held open for every second you talk.
A text is one tiny burst, up to 160 characters.
It needs less signal, and the network can hold it, then deliver it in a gap.
So emergency guides say: to check in, text instead of calling.
Before a busy event, agree a meeting point, so one short text is enough.
Download Meshline for nearby messaging, even offline.
